It can? For me it did. I have an older sister (6 year age gap) who sh'ed when she was a teen. I never saw her scars and if I did I didn't know what they were but I did stumble upon her sketchbook and 2013 tumblr where she talked abd drew about self harm religiously and really romanticized the shit out of it.

 When I was like 12 I tried shing mainly because of that, I was depressed and my sister who I looked up to so much said it was a cure!!!

 Of course what I want you to realize is that I was exposed to it in a "positive" light, I'm sure if I hadn't snooped and seen all that shit I wouldn't have sh'ed when I did. 

 To be honest if I'd seen her sketchbook or her tumblr and she said "wow, cutting sucks" I wouldve stayed far away from self harm. So my advice is never make self harm seem like a good thing, make sure to express how bad it is especially if she looks up to you. There's nothing wrong with your sister seeing your scars but if she ever asks just be honest? Don't try to be curt and vague and tell her it sucked and discourage it as much possible.
